title: claude-project
asked: Backfilled from CLAUDE.md Status (built before builds reported themselves).

result.summary: `framework/cli/claude-project.mjs` (= `axf claude-project`, the `claude-project` shell command and `/claude-project` in any Claude Code session; `deploy/claude-pick.sh --install` installs both globally). Run in any folder: detects the stack and the AXF relation, writes a validated `project.manifest.

commits.message: Add claude-project: one command that makes any folder a Claude project with a home on GitHub, the VPS or the device, and parks AXF ports for Fable
Harden the project wizard and claude-project: no writes through symlinks, safer folder sources, only their own files committed
